_doc: Built-in interiors (22 Nov 2026 pilot): what fills a kit building's hand-placed slot markers, per shop kind. A slot marker (Marker3D in <model>_interior.scn, meta slot_type, variant, lift) takes sets[kind][slot_type][variant]. There is NO fallback: a kind without a set, a slot type the set does not name, a variant out of range or a prop file that does not exist fails the validator and the bake (so a room can never be filled with stray plants). 'required' = slot types every model offering this kind must have. Props are kit indoor props (assets/coronado_kit/props/indoor, file base without prop_ and _clean_near).
